_A_COMBOBOX_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: ACombobox is a text field with suggestions: the text is free, a suggestion fills it. Unlike ASelect the value is the text, not an entry of a list. The suggestions come from the data or from the server.
_A_COMBOBOX_ACCESSIBILITY_DESCRIPTION_: Accessibility (WAI-ARIA combobox): the input has role="combobox" and the focus stays in it, aria-activedescendant shows the active suggestion. ArrowDown and ArrowUp move in the list, Alt+ArrowDown opens it, Enter takes the active suggestion, Escape closes the list and then clears the text, Tab leaves the field. The number of suggestions is read in a live region, the found text is marked.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_BASIC_DESCRIPTION_: The data are filtered by the text (also in the middle of a word). select gets the chosen suggestion with id, label and item; an own text is also allowed.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_OPTIONS_DESCRIPTION_: An array of strings with is-data-simple-array. min-length 0 and open-on-focus show the list at the focus, max-items limits it.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_SERVER_DESCRIPTION_: With url the field asks the server after a pause (search-timeout): GET url?search=text (search-api-key). The server filters, an older answer does not replace a newer one, a spinner shows the loading. The file of these docs is static and gives all entries back.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_FORM_DESCRIPTION_: In AForm the field has type: "combobox".
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_DATA_DESCRIPTION_: Local suggestions: objects (key-id, key-label) or strings (is-data-simple-array).
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_IN_BODY_DESCRIPTION_: The list is in a container in body and placed at the field (floating-ui): a parent with overflow: hidden (table, modal) does not cut it.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_IS_BOTTOM_SHEET_ON_MOB: On a small screen (AMobilePlugin) the list is a panel at the bottom of the window, above the virtual keyboard (visualViewport). The focus stays in the field.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_POPPER_CONTAINER_ID_DE: Id of the container in body for in-body and the bottom sheet.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_Z_INDEX_DESCRIPTION_: Stack order of the list. Without it the token --a_combobox_z_index: above modals, so the list in AModal is visible. Set a smaller value if the list must stay under own fixed layers.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_IS_CLEAR_BUTTON_DESCRI: Shows a button that clears the text. The default can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_IS_DATA_SIMPLE_ARRAY_D: The data are an array of strings or numbers.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_KEY_ID_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the id in the data.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the text of a suggestion in the data.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_KEY_LABEL_CALLBACK_DES: Text of a suggestion from a function: ({ item }) => ….
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_MIN_LENGTH_DESCRIPTION: Number of characters from which the list opens.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_OPEN_ON_FOCUS_DESCRIPT: Opens the list at the focus (with min-length 0 also without text).
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_SEARCH_API_KEY_DESCRIP: Name of the parameter of the text for the server.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_DESCRIP: Pause in ms before the request to the server.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_TRANSLATE_DATA_DESCRIP: The texts of the data are translation keys.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_URL_DESCRIPTION_: Address of the server for the suggestions (it filters by the text).
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_URL_TEMPLATE_DATA_DESC: Values for placeholders in the url: api/{{ id }}/.
_A_COMBOBOX_EVENTS_SELECT_DESCRIPTION_: A suggestion was taken (Enter or click): { id, label, item }.
_A_COMBOBOX_ACCESSIBILITY_MORE_DESCRIPTI: With an active suggestion Home and End go to the first and the last suggestion (without one they move the caret), PageDown and PageUp go 10 suggestions further. Disabled suggestions (key-disabled) have aria-disabled and are skipped. A group has a header, the screen reader reads it with the suggestion. With inline-autocomplete the field has aria-autocomplete="both": the added text is selected, typing replaces it, Backspace removes it, Enter or Tab takes it.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_GROUPS_DESCRIPTION_: key-group puts the suggestions into groups with a header (WAI-ARIA grouped listbox), the suggestions of a group stay together. key-disabled shows a suggestion that can not be chosen.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_FILTER_DESCRIPTION_: filter-mode startsWith finds only the start of a suggestion, ignore-diacritics (default) finds Zürich with zur. inline-autocomplete completes the text with the first suggestion, the added part is selected. filter-callback is an own filter.
_A_COMBOBOX_GROUP_SLOT_DESCRIPTION_: The slot option shows own content of a suggestion, highlight is the text with the marked match. texts changes the texts of the status, a missing key keeps its default.
_A_COMBOBOX_SLOTS_OPTION_DESCRIPTION_: Own content of a suggestion. Props: { item, label, parts, highlight, isActive, isDisabled, index }.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_FILTER_CALLBACK_DESCRI: Own filter of the local data: ({ item, label, search }) => boolean.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_FILTER_MODE_DESCRIPTIO: contains: the text in any place, startsWith: only at the start.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_IGNORE_DIACRITICS_DESC: The search ignores diacritics: munchen finds München, the mark covers the original chars.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_INLINE_AUTOCOMPLETE_DE: The first suggestion completes the text in the field, the added part is selected (aria-autocomplete="both").
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_KEY_DISABLED_DESCRIPTI: Key in the data: a true value shows the suggestion as disabled, it can not be chosen.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_KEY_GROUP_DESCRIPTION_: Key of the group in the data: the suggestions of a group stay together under a header.
_A_COMBOBOX_PROPS_TEXTS_DESCRIPTION_: Texts of the status: loading, noResults, results ({{ count }}). Every missing key keeps its default, the defaults can be set with AComponentsPlugin.
